研究部維持長廣買進投資建議，係因：（1）推估在手訂單 45億元
（+580%YoY），已達 25 年營收的 2.5倍，能見度延續至 2030年；
（2）2027年產能成長 +63%，2030年新廠投產再成長 +81%；（3）公
司積極切入新應用如EMIB、四段式、玻璃基板、晶圓級壓模，最快
2027年逐步落地。綜上所述，公司預期營收躍升將提前至 3Q26 發
生，微幅上修 26 年營收從 30.1 億元提升至 30.7 億元（+62%YoY），
預期漲價、設備升級、產品組合有望帶動毛利率持續提升，預期毛利
率從 46.9% 提升至 47.4%，使得 26 年稅後 EPS 從 5.24 元上修
至 5.47 元。展望 27 年，公司擴產節奏提前，加上 27 年擴產幅度
上修 1-2 成，預期在產能滿載加上漲價效應下，27 年營收從 69.0
億元上修至 88.9 億元（+190%YoY），毛利率從 52.9% 上修至 54.7%，
預期 27 年稅後 EPS 從 18.83 元上修到 24.19 元。考量公司具高
市占率領導地位，合約負債與擴產幅度不斷上修，同時積極發展多項
半導體新應用。公司2H26即將進入營收爆發期，長期成長趨勢陡峭
且明確，研究部給予 27 年 33 倍 PE，目標價從原先 600 元上修
到 800 元（2027 EPS*33xPER）。

AI 與HPC 帶動的先進封測與測試需求成長快速，日
月光投控再度上調先進封測(LEAP)營收，將超越先前設定35 億
美元目標，2027 年LEAP 營收有望再增加1 倍；一般封測成長
率預估由先前YoY+13%上修至YoY+20%。整體ATM 業務2026
年營收預期YoY+35%。EMS 營收略低於YoY+20%。預估日月
光投控2026 年稅後EPS 17.95 元。全球超大規模資料中心正加
速升級，為支撐具備多模態能力的複雜推論，晶片設計已大量
轉向由多顆小晶片與高頻寬記憶體堆疊的系統架構，使台積電
CoWoS 產能無不應求。日月光受惠台積電訂單外溢，加上大客
戶AMD 的次世代Venice CPU 架構開始放量，日月光的FOCoS
出貨向上，將帶動營收續創新高，因此對日月光投控投資建議
為Buy，目標價為862 元(2027 年PER35X)。

VPEC’s Jul and Aug revenue delivered double digit YoY growth, or 
23% / 25% higher than our estimate, reflecting strong AI data center 
optical networking demand, InP substrate supply getting better, and 
VPEC’s continuous customers penetration. We expect sequential 
revenues growth through Dec 2026, leading 3Q26 / 4Q26E revenues 
at 44% / 23% QoQ, and the product mix upgrade toward AI data 
center optical networking would continue to drive the GM 
expansion. VPEC’s July net margin up to 27% from 18% / 22% in 
3Q25 / 2Q26, reflecting the strong product mix upgrade. Maintain 
Buy with 12M TP raised to NT$793 (implied 69x 2027E PE vs. +61%
NI YoY in 2027-28E).

展望2026 年，AI 基礎設施的需求正帶動整體市場
復甦，並外溢至記憶體、網通與電源管理領域，然消費性電子
(如手機、PC)終端需求仍偏弱，且庫存天數有微幅上升的跡象。
儘管如此，聯電預期其2026 年整體晶圓出貨量仍將成長，特別
是在22/28 nm 與8 吋的市占率持續提升。聯電預估2026 年AI
相關營收將近3 億美元，並預期3 年內突破10 億美元大關。預
估聯電2026 年稅後EPS 7.72 元。公司在先進封裝(interposer 或
矽電容等)、矽光子及Intel 合作的12nm 陸續取得進展，為2027
年後中長期成長奠定基礎。雖聯電2Q26 獲利大多以投資收益
為主，3Q26 股市成長動能相對弱，可能壓抑業外收益，但本業
獲利逐步回升，建議Buy，目標價169 元。

items.story:
Despite a feeble linkage with AI demand thus far, we believe UMC’s developments in AI
peripherals such as silicon photonics (SiPh) and silicon capacitors (Si-cap) may start
contributing more meaningfully from 2028F. UMC’s current AI-related revenue is at an annual
scale of USD300mn (which we believe factors in almost nil from SiPh or Si-cap) and will top
USD1bn in three years, according to management. This could be a rather reserved
estimate, compared with the strong demand facing UMC in both SiPh and Si-cap. Assuming a
right execution by UMC (in both SiPh and Si-cap process qualification and tool move-in by
2027F), we now expect UMC to generate ~USD1bn sales from them by 2028F, including
UMC’s industry-leading thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) investments. To pursue these
profitable growth opportunities, we expect UMC to lift its capex in 2027-28F. The additional
inputs could alter the fixed-cost corridor and result in around low-teens y-y depreciation growth
in 2027-28F, but we still expect GM expansion to 40.1%/41.5% in 2027-28F thanks to more
favorable mature-node foundry pricing conditions and accretive contribution from SiPh and Si-
cap (the quotes of which are much higher than for comparable nodes). We therefore fine-tune
2026F EPS from TWD7.51 to TWD7.38, and raise 2027F/28F EPS 3%/9% to factor in
marginally higher utilization rate assumptions, incremental profit from SiPh and Si-cap (mainly
in 2028F), and higher associate income (mainly from Unimicron [3037 TT, Buy]). Our current
model does not yet bake in the contribution from the 12nm partnership with Intel (INTC US,
Not rated). We lift our TP to TWD176 (from TWD140) based on 20x average 2027-28F EPS of
TWD8.8 (from 18x 2027F basic EPS of TWD7.7). Our target multiple of 20x is at the higher
end of UMC’s historical range on a more resilient outlook. UMC currently trades at 17x 2027F
basic EPS.

on 2029E (methodology unchanged). We continue to derive the target P/E multiple from 
the average PEG&M ratio of peers in the satellite supply chain, and we remove outliers 
(those below 0.3x, which are mostly telecom operators who face competition from LEO 
satellite operators or having consumer electronics exposure which suffered from high 
memory costs). Our target 2029E discounted P/E multiple is at 37.0x (unchanged) which 
is based on peers’ avg. PEG&M, and UMT’s 2029-30E avg. NI YoY and OPM. We apply the 
37.0x multiple to 2029E EPS and discount it back to 2027E via a COE of 7.8% (no 
change). Our target price is at NT$2,557 (vs. NT$2,513 previously), implying 61x 2027E 
P/E, which is above the company’s average +1 stv. P/E of 42x, reflecting our positive view 
on UMT’s product mix upgrade toward LEO satellites. Maintain Buy.

items.story:
WinWay’s share price corrected ~35% in July (TWSE down 8%), mainly on its GM miss in
2Q26. The share price has fluctuated over the past two months, with
periodic upward momentum, particularly following the release of strong July/ August
revenue figures in early Aug/ early Sep. However, the stock hit its limit down on 7 Oct,
following a 27% m-m decline in Sep revenue and a 3Q26 revenue miss (+29% q-q vs.
NMR/BBG’s +35-40% q-q). We expect revenue momentum to naturally moderate, as
some key probe card projects enter the later stages of their shipment cycle. However, the
strength in the socket segment appears insufficient to fully offset the slowdown in the
probe card segment. For 4Q, we revise our revenue forecast from single-digit q-q growth
to a mid-to-high single-digit q-q decline (vs. BBG expectation of single-digit q-q growth),
as our earlier estimates were based primarily on capacity expansion assumptions. We
have since refined our projections to incorporate actual project shipping patterns. While
4Q is likely to be a product transition period for both sockets and probe cards from one
major XPU vendor — with new project ramps scheduled for next year — we do see other
key ASIC/XPU projects ramp gradually. We thus slightly cut 2026F EPS by 4%, and still
expect 2027-28F revenue to grow ~70% y-y, respectively. Based on our revised earnings,
we lower TP from TWD9,000 to TWD8,250, still on 32x 2027-28F EPS. We reaffirm Buy
considering the broad project base and intact mid-to-long term outlook, on top of its solid
share in key customer programs, in our view. The stock currently trades at 21.4x.

落、原料成本遞延反映及美洲線運費上漲影響，下修3Q26毛利
率與獲利預估。預估3Q26稅後EPS 1.49元，-
19.7%QoQ/+65.8%YoY。(2) 4Q26進入美國傳統營運淡季，獲利
動能預期轉弱。考量2H26海運成本上升，預估2026年、2027年
稅後EPS分別為5.64元、6.06元，分別成長118.4%、7.4%YoY。
歷史本淨比區間為1.0~2.0倍，考量2H26獲利預估下修，評價
提升空間有限，故以2027年底預估每股淨值36.20元為評價基
礎，給予1.3倍本淨比，目標價47元，將投資評等調降至中立。

研究部對復盛應用營運看法依舊正向。雖然受海運船期影響，部分
出貨遞延，短期營收表現相對平淡。不過，第四季訂單掌握度已達
八至九成，旺季營收仍會如同先前預期衝高，預估4Q26營收有望
創歷史新高。展望2027年，高球球具訂單仍能成長，預期業績繼
續穩健提升。研究部預估復盛應用2026EPS 27.04元(+21%YoY)、
2026EPS 28.29元(+5%YoY)。考量復盛應用第四季成長動能明確，
且目前評價依舊偏低，研究部給予11.5xPER，目標價325元，維持
買進評等。

Following our Largan upgrade in Jul, we now expect greater long-term earnings upside 
from the CPO business, supported by: 1) management guidance for higher ASP and 
shipments and 2) its recent purchases of multiple land parcels and buildings. We cut 
2026-27E earnings by 9-14% to reflect its soft Apple business, as mgmt. toned down 
the demand outlook. However, we raise 2028E earnings by 3% on CPO upside. We lift 
our PO to NT$8,000 (35x 2028E P/E; was 25x) from NT$5,600. We believe 35x is 
justified by the firm’s better-than-expected progress and strong earnings growth in 
2029/30E (Exhibit 6). We see the market views Largan as a strong competitor to TFC, 
the current sole supplier. In addition, Taiwan has few optics suppliers, so positive

研究部維持南亞(1303)之投資建議為買進，主要考量：(1)南亞7
月自結稅後EPS 0.4元，雖不如6月自結稅後EPS 2.88元，但因
6月有包含權益法認列收益不具可比性，而具可比性的4、5、7月
自結稅前淨利率分別是9.4%、13%、15.7%，歸母淨利率為4.7%、
9.2%、10.4%，獲利顯著持續提升，符合研究部預期。營收方面，
7+8月營收達成率70.6%，優於預期，公司展望9月營收將優於8
月，4Q26的營收將優於3Q26，整體營運維持正向。(2)應用於AI
伺服器的M6-M8高階大訂單目前正與客戶洽談生產配合及廠區產
線對接等細節，預計將於4Q26完成協商並開始有明顯進展，帶動
後續營收與利潤大幅優化，去瓶頸後的30萬張CCL產能將全數投
入高階產品生產。(3)廠商持續將擴產資源湧入中高階材料，導致
以PCB為主軸的玻纖布、銅箔、CCL、ABF載板等中低階電子材料
依然緊缺，研究部預期南亞電子材料漲價態勢將延續。此外，南亞
積極推動AI供應鏈高階材料的開發、認證與銷售，有顯著成效，
2027年電子相關獲利占比也將提升至98%，電子材料占比可望達
70-80%，優於研究部原先預估的65-70%。(4)子公司方面，受惠AI
需求旺盛，南電產能有限但需求持續放大，ABF載板漲價效應延續，
2026、2027年業績皆會有明顯提升；南亞科受惠記憶體供需缺口
再擴大，利潤急速成長。(5)近期石化產品EG價格大漲，利差顯著
擴大，對獲利明顯幫助，若市況持續好轉，更明顯的獲利貢獻會落
在4Q26。研究部分別上修南亞2026年、2027年稅後EPS至13.82
元、21.64元(原估12.02元、16.94元)，分別+2,325%YoY、
+56.6%YoY，年底淨值69.8元、91.4元。研究部認為2027年CSP
業者對整機成本及零組件價格控管趨嚴，加上上游原料新增產能於
2H27至1H28陸續開出，電子材料及CCL業者議價能力會降低，因
此將電子材料目標評價調降至20倍，惟考量目前股價隱含電子材
料評價僅約12倍，評價極低，故維持南亞買進投資建議。以2027
年電子材料:南亞科:傳產獲利占比48:50:2，電子與傳產淨值占比
約4：6之比例推算，目標價調升至320元(20xPER*2027本業電子
材料EPS + 5xPER*2027南亞科貢獻稅後EPS + 1xPBR*2027傳產
BVPS)。

已過，預期11M26開始轉弱，手機需求受到記憶體及相關零組件成
本上漲不如預期，加上綠電成本短期難以完全轉嫁，預期4Q26手
機業務獲利改善幅度有限；CPO業務方面，FA已通過客戶認證，客
戶進一步要求由FA延伸至完整FAU，並爭取Carrier整合製程，
預計2H27逐步量產，惟考量初期產能爬坡及客戶新專案導入時程，
預期2028年才有望看到較明顯的營收與獲利貢獻。綜上所述， 
2026/2027年營收研究部分別從682億元/708億元下修至597億
/682億(-2.3%YoY/+14.1%YoY)，EPS從186.3/205.1元下修至
159/180.8元。評價方面，研究部認同大立光逐步轉型為CPO業務，
因此評價從原先的25X PER上調至40X PER，目標價從5175元上
調至7200元，惟考量目前股價潛在上漲空間有限，因此調降至中
立投資建議，建議待股價回落後再行布局。

調至7200元，惟考量目前股價潛在上漲空間有限，因此調降至中
立投資建議，建議待股價回落後再行布局。
